description: Defines a strongly-typed class `FeatureFlags` for managing feature toggle settings in a Flutter app. Supports loading feature flags from environment variables via dotenv, with safe defaults.

classes.name: FeatureFlags
classes.description: A class representing feature toggle flags with properties for online play, AI mode, store, and profile features. Can be instantiated from environment variables.

methods.name: FeatureFlags.fromDotEnv
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates a `FeatureFlags` instance by reading environment variable values via a `DotEnv` object.

methods.name: _readBool
methods.description: Static helper method that interprets environment variable string values as boolean, with support for common true/false representations, returning a default if invalid or missing.
